answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded work trellis: each new identity must stake locked POA and publish a signed capability proof before earning. A quill-stamped attest ledger records every peer countersignature; forged clones fail quorum because their history has no matching peer echo. Attackers pay the stake per head and burn reputation when panels reject duplicated prose, so farming many shells costs more than one honest miner earns.
